title: Police Find 75-Year-Old Woman In the Street Beat Blind
description:
Seattle police bodycam footage captures the moment officers respond to a brutal unprovoked attack on a 75-year-old woman near a crosswalk. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.

Grounded in expert narration and insightful commentary from a trusted journalist and attorney, each episode of BodyCam features high-stakes situations with expert analysis.
